{{Top|leg}}
'''Soda water''' was a beverage served in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. They were stored in drums, and [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droids]] such as the [[MixRMastR]] were connected to the drums via tubes.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
